decisive_items: multiloculated complex pelvic mass with thick septations measuring 24 × 18 cm
Serum CA-125 was elevated at 95 U/mL
a predominantly cystic mass measuring 28.3 × 24.4 × 16.3 cm extending from the pelvis to the upper abdomen
response.rationale: R1 uniquely combines the large complex ovarian mass with elevated CA-125, consistent with ovarian cystadenocarcinoma. Other candidates either lack CA-125 support or have contradictions with the mass or CA-125.

rejected.why: Only latent tuberculosis, no mass or CA-125 support.
Endometriosis contradicted by the large adnexal mass and complex septations.
Diverticulitis lacks the ovarian mass and CA-125.
Ovarian torsion contradicted by elevated CA-125.
PID contradicted by the large mass and CA-125.
Dermoid cyst contradicted by elevated CA-125.
Mucinous cystadenoma contradicted by elevated CA-125.
Serous cystadenoma contradicted by elevated CA-125.
Tuberculous ovarian cyst contradicted by CA-125 and cystic mass.
Ovarian neoplasm is too broad; R1 is more specific.
